facts.fact: In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, YouTube viewing rose 6% versus June, and Nielsen called its share a record for the streamer.
facts.quote: YouTube viewing rose 6% versus June. Nielsen also called it a record for the streamer

facts.fact: In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, the Media Distributor Gauge lead for YouTube widened to 5.0 share points.
facts.quote: the lead in the Media Distributor Gauge widened to 5.0 share points

facts.fact: Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge reported streaming as a category at 49.0% of total TV, up 0.5 points.
facts.quote: Streaming as a category was 49.0% of total TV (+0.5 points), with usage up 3.4% versus June.

facts.fact: In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, streaming usage was up 3.4% versus June.
Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge put Disney's combined streaming properties at 4.7% of TV, a portfolio figure and not a Disney+ standalone number.
facts.quote: Disney streaming properties | 4.7% | Combined streaming properties, +0.1 point, usage +4% versus June.

facts.fact: Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge put Peacock at 2.6% of TV, up 0.3 points, with viewing up 15% versus June.
facts.quote: Peacock | 2.6% | Share of TV, +0.3 points. Viewing +15% versus June.

facts.fact: Nielsen reported Love Island USA as the most-streamed title on Peacock in July 2026, with 4.9 billion viewing minutes in July.
facts.quote: Love Island USA was the most-streamed title again, with 4.9 billion viewing minutes in July

facts.fact: In Nielsen's May 2026 Gauge, YouTube was at 13.8% of TV time, up 0.4 points, and was the top media distributor.
facts.quote: YouTube | 13.8% | Platform-best at the time. +0.4 points. Also the top media distributor.

facts.fact: Nielsen's May 2026 Gauge put Prime Video at 4.5% of TV, its best share to date, up 0.3 points.
facts.quote: Prime Video | 4.5% | Best share of TV to date. +0.3 points.

facts.fact: Nielsen's May 2026 Gauge put The Roku Channel at 3.1% of TV, a new platform best, up 0.1 point.
facts.quote: The Roku Channel | 3.1% | New platform best. +0.1 point. Total TV usage.

facts.fact: Nielsen's May 2026 Gauge put Paramount Streaming (Paramount+ and Pluto TV combined) at 2.3% of TV, up 0.2 points.
facts.quote: Paramount Streaming | 2.3% | Paramount+ and Pluto TV combined. +0.2 points.

facts.fact: Nielsen's May 2026 Media Distributor Gauge put Netflix at 8.0% of TV usage, No. 4 among distributors, up 0.2 points.
facts.quote: Netflix in the May release is a Media Distributor Gauge figure: 8.0% of TV usage, No. 4 among distributors, +0.2 points

facts.fact: Nielsen's May 2026 Media Distributor Gauge put Disney's parent-company share at 10.0% of TV, including ESPN cable sports telecasts.
facts.quote: In May, Disney's company share was 10.0% of TV. That includes ESPN's NBA playoff cable telecasts.

facts.fact: Nielsen's Media Distributor Gauge put FOX at 7.8% of TV in July 2026 on World Cup viewing, and this is not Tubi's share.
facts.quote: The distributor chart has FOX at 7.4% of TV in June and 7.8% in July, on World Cup viewing. That is not Tubi's share.

facts.fact: Nielsen said it adjusted Tubi measurement parameters in June 2026 and was still evaluating the impact, and the July release printed no Tubi percentage.
facts.quote: Nielsen said it adjusted Tubi parameters in June and is still evaluating the impact, and the July release did not print a Tubi percentage.

facts.fact: The Adwave Q2 2026 page cites Nielsen's April 2026 Gauge (released June 25, 2026) with YouTube at 13.4%, Netflix at 7.8%, and Prime Video at 4.2%.
facts.quote: YouTube 13.4%, Netflix 7.8%, Prime Video 4.2%, and the other April rows, from the April Gauge released June 25, 2026.
